title: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
paperTitle: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
prompt: Suppose your university is conducting a survey to collect students' opinions on the appropriate use of AI technology in assisting learning. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: In my view, AI technology, when used appropriately, is a valuable ally in learning rather than a shortcut that replaces genuine effort. Since our university is surveying students on this issue, I would like to voice my support for embracing AI in a sensible, balanced way. There are solid reasons for this position. First, AI tools raise learning efficiency: a chatbot can explain a confusing grammar point instantly, check my essay for mistakes, or gather background material that once took hours in the library. Second, AI offers personalized tutoring, adjusting its explanations to my own pace and weak spots. Admittedly, however, over-reliance is a real danger; if students let AI think for them, their own analytical skills will gradually wither. Therefore, the key lies in "appropriate" use. We should treat AI as an assistant that guides and inspires, not a machine that hands us ready-made answers. Used within this boundary, AI can truly make learning smarter.
keyPoints: 两句完成表态与扣题。首句 In my view... rather than a shortcut 用「亮明观点」句架一句 站队，第二句 Since our university is surveying students... 用「回应语境」句架接住调查背景，落实了 表态段「亮立场＋点价值」的功能。
分点举例加让步显辩证。There are solid reasons 领起后，First / Second 切出效率与个性 化两条理由，explain... check... or gather 用「举例落地」把好处具象化；Admittedly, however, over- reliance is a real danger 用「让步转折」补上风险，正扣 appropriate 的边界感。
回扣题眼并划边界收口。Therefore, the key lies in "appropriate" use 用「回扣题眼」把落 点钉回核心词，an assistant... not a machine 给出具体边界，末句 Used within this boundary... 升华 作结，与开头立场首尾呼应。
